text: XYZ Technologies Private Limited Employee Handbook Policy ID: HR-HANDBOOK-001 Version: 2.0 Effective Date: 1 April 2026 Owner: People Operations Classification: Internal  -  Employee Reference Demo notice: This is a fictional company policy created for testing an HR RAG application. It is not a real company's policy or legal advice.
XYZ Technologies is a fictional software, cloud and AI services company headquartered in Hyderabad, India. It builds business applications, data platforms and AI-enabled products.
Mission: Build trustworthy technology that makes complex work simpler. Values: Customer Focus, Ownership, Integrity, Learning, Inclusion, Simplicity and Responsible Innovation.
XYZ uses a hybrid model for eligible roles. Standard working days are Monday through Friday. Core collaboration hours are 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM IST unless an approved shift arrangement applies.
The active leave policy provides Annual Leave, Sick Leave and Casual Leave. Employees normally apply through the HR portal and obtain manager approval. See HR-LEAVE-001.
Employees must act honestly, respectfully and professionally, protect company information and disclose conflicts of interest. See HR-CONDUCT-001.
Eligible employees may receive medical insurance, accident cover, learning support and employee assistance resources. See HR-BEN-001.
Company devices, accounts and data must be used responsibly. See IT-SEC-001.
Employees participate in goal setting, quarterly check-ins and a formal annual review.
Employees leaving XYZ must follow notice, knowledge-transfer, asset-return and exit-clearance procedures. See HR-EXIT-001.

People Operations reviews policies periodically. The company may amend or replace policies. Where a more specific approved policy applies, that policy governs. Applicable law and the employee's employment agreement take

XYZ Technologies Private Limited Leave and Time-Off Policy Policy ID: HR-LEAVE-001 Version: 2.0 Effective Date: 1 April 2026 Owner: People Operations Classification: Internal  -  Employee Reference Demo notice: This is a fictional company policy created for testing an HR RAG application. It is not a real company's policy or legal advice.

Leave Type Annual Entitlement Typical Use Approval Annual Leave 18 working days Planned vacation/personal time Manager Sick Leave 10 working days Illness/recovery Manager; documentation may be requested Casual Leave 6 working days Short personal needs Manager
Planned leave should normally be submitted at least 3 working days before the start date. Managers should normally respond within 2 working days.
Employees should notify their manager as soon as reasonably possible when illness or an emergency prevents attendance. Supporting documentation may be requested for extended or repeated absence.
Up to 12 unused Annual Leave days may be carried into the following leave year. Unused Casual Leave expires at year-end.
Leave during a notice period requires manager and People Operations approval and may be restricted when it would materially affect transition activities.
Absence without notification or approved leave may be treated as unauthorised absence and may result in corrective action.

XYZ Technologies Private Limited Remote and Hybrid Work Policy Policy ID: HR-WFH-001 Version: 1.0 Effective Date: 1 April 2026 Owner: People Operations Classification: Internal  -  Employee Reference Demo notice: This is a fictional company policy created for testing an HR RAG application. It is not a real company's policy or legal advice.
Hybrid or remote work may be available for roles that can be performed effectively away from the office. Eligibility depends on role, team requirements, performance and manager approval.
Eligible employees normally work from the office at least 2 days per week. Teams may designate additional office days for collaboration, training or customer requirements.
Employees must be reachable during core collaboration hours from 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM IST unless an approved flexible schedule applies.
Planned remote days require manager approval through the approved HR/team workflow.
Employees must use approved devices, MFA, secure networks and screen locking. Confidential information must not be discussed where unauthorized people can overhear it.
Extended work from another city or country requires written approval because payroll, tax, security and compliance considerations may apply.

XYZ Technologies Private Limited Attendance and Working Hours Policy Policy ID: HR-ATT-001 Version: 1.0 Effective Date: 1 April 2026 Owner: People Operations Classification: Internal  -  Employee Reference Demo notice: This is a fictional company policy created for testing an HR RAG application. It is not a real company's policy or legal advice.
Standard office hours are 9:30 AM to 6:30 PM, Monday through Friday, with a one-hour meal break. Shift teams follow assigned schedules.
Employees must accurately record attendance through the approved HR system.
Occasional delays should be communicated to the manager. Repeated unexplained late arrival may lead to corrective action.
Approved travel, client-site work, remote work and system outages should be recorded using the applicable attendance exception process.
Saturday and Sunday are standard weekly off days for Monday-Friday teams unless the employee's shift arrangement states otherwise.

XYZ Technologies Private Limited Travel and Expense Reimbursement Policy Policy ID: FIN-EXP-001 Version: 1.0 Effective Date: 1 April 2026 Owner: People Operations Classification: Internal  -  Employee Reference Demo notice: This is a fictional company policy created for testing an HR RAG application. It is not a real company's policy or legal advice.
Business travel expected to exceed ■10,000 in estimated total cost requires manager approval before booking. International travel may require additional approval.
Reasonable approved travel, accommodation, local transportation, customer meals and business supplies may be reimbursable.
Standard domestic hotel reimbursement is capped at ■4,500 per night for Levels L1-L3 and ■6,500 for Levels L4-L6, excluding applicable taxes.
Claims must normally be submitted within 30 calendar days after the expense date and include receipts and a business purpose.
Falsified receipts, personal expenses claimed as business expenses or intentional splitting of claims to bypass limits may result in disciplinary action.

XYZ Technologies Private Limited Code of Conduct and Workplace Behaviour Policy Policy ID: HR-CONDUCT-001 Version: 1.0 Effective Date: 1 April 2026 Owner: People Operations Classification: Internal  -  Employee Reference Demo notice: This is a fictional company policy created for testing an HR RAG application. It is not a real company's policy or legal advice.
Employees are expected to communicate respectfully, act honestly and maintain professional conduct with colleagues, customers and partners.
Employees must disclose actual or potential conflicts, including outside activities or financial interests that could influence company decisions.
Employees must not accept or offer cash or cash-equivalent gifts in connection with business decisions. Gifts that could create an obligation must be declined or disclosed.
Confidential information includes customer data, source code, product plans, pricing, internal financial information and employee personal information.
Employees must not disclose confidential information or imply that personal opinions are official company statements.
XYZ prohibits retaliation against a person who raises a concern in good faith or participates in an investigation.

XYZ Technologies Private Limited Employee Benefits Policy Policy ID: HR-BEN-001 Version: 1.0 Effective Date: 1 April 2026 Owner: People Operations Classification: Internal  -  Employee Reference Demo notice: This is a fictional company policy created for testing an HR RAG application. It is not a real company's policy or legal advice.
Eligible employees receive access to the company group medical insurance plan according to the insurer's terms.
Eligible employees may receive company-provided personal accident coverage subject to the applicable plan.
Eligible employees may access confidential employee assistance resources described in the benefits portal.
Eligible employees may claim up to ■20,000 per financial year for approved professional learning, certifications or technical courses, subject to manager approval and budget.
Employees approved for long-term remote work may receive internet reimbursement up to ■1,000 per month, subject to eligibility and submission requirements.
Benefits are subject to plan terms and may be changed or replaced. The official benefits portal and plan documents govern.

XYZ Technologies Private Limited IT Acceptable Use and Information Security Policy Policy ID: IT-SEC-001 Version: 1.0 Effective Date: 1 April 2026 Owner: People Operations Classification: Internal  -  Employee Reference Demo notice: This is a fictional company policy created for testing an HR RAG application. It is not a real company's policy or legal advice.
Employees must use company accounts for company business. Passwords must be unique and must not be shared.
Multi-factor authentication is mandatory for systems that support it. Suspected account compromise must be reported immediately.
Company laptops must use approved security software, screen locking and supported operating-system versions.

Level Examples Handling Public Published website content May be shared externally Internal Internal procedures Authorized workers only Confidential Customer contracts, product plans Need-to-know access Restricted Credentials, sensitive personal data Strong access controls; never share casually
Employees must report suspicious links, unexpected MFA prompts, malware, lost devices or accidental data disclosure to IT Security immediately.
Restricted or confidential company/customer information must not be pasted into unapproved public AI tools. Only approved enterprise AI services may be used for company data.

XYZ Technologies Private Limited Performance and Career Development Policy Policy ID: HR-PERF-001 Version: 1.0 Effective Date: 1 April 2026 Owner: People Operations Classification: Internal  -  Employee Reference Demo notice: This is a fictional company policy created for testing an HR RAG application. It is not a real company's policy or legal advice.
Employees and managers establish measurable goals at the beginning of each performance cycle.
XYZ uses quarterly check-ins and a formal annual performance review.
Five levels: Exceptional, Exceeds Expectations, Meets Expectations, Partially Meets Expectations and Does Not Meet Expectations.
Promotion decisions consider sustained performance, role scope, competencies, business need and readiness for the next level. Promotion is not automatic based solely on tenure.
Where performance is materially below expectations, a manager may initiate a Performance Improvement Plan with measurable expectations, support and review checkpoints.

XYZ Technologies Private Limited Separation and Exit Policy Policy ID: HR-EXIT-001 Version: 1.0 Effective Date: 1 April 2026 Owner: People Operations Classification: Internal  -  Employee Reference Demo notice: This is a fictional company policy created for testing an HR RAG application. It is not a real company's policy or legal advice.
Employees should submit resignations through the official HR system. The notice period is the period stated in the employment agreement.
Employees must complete reasonable knowledge-transfer activities and document active work during notice.
Company laptops, access cards, tokens, documents and other assets must be returned by the final working day unless an approved exception exists.
IT will disable or modify access according to the approved separation schedule. Employees must not copy company data to personal accounts before departure.
Final payroll and eligible reimbursements are processed according to company procedures and applicable requirements after required clearances.
Eligible employees receive separation documents after required exit formalities are completed.
